purpose: Cross-design clinical and health evidence system evaluation

dimensions.name: 发现筛选与研究关联
dimensions.question: 是否找到并正确识别该用的证据
dimensions.observations: 审定参考集中的研究召回、筛选敏感度、误纳、报告与研究或队列关联错误

dimensions.name: 来源与主张支持
dimensions.question: 结论能否回到真实且支持它的来源
dimensions.observations: 引文真实性、主张支持精确率、必需主张引用召回、页段定位、版本完整性

dimensions.name: 数据与语义忠实
dimensions.question: 数字、定义和缺失是否保真
dimensions.observations: 组别、分母、单位、结局、时点、效应、方差和原始字段正确率

dimensions.name: 问题与方法匹配
dimensions.question: 是否选择适用设计、工具和推断
dimensions.observations: PICOTS、目标效应、设计识别、RoB 工具匹配、混杂和因果限制

dimensions.name: 综合与数值有效性
dimensions.question: 合并和计算是否成立
dimensions.observations: 独立 k、兼容分析单元、效应尺度、CI、异质性、敏感性和拒绝不当合并

dimensions.name: 确定性与校准
dimensions.question: 对知道和不知道是否判断适当
dimensions.observations: 逐重要结局的确定性理由、过度确定率、适当拒答；概率输出另测 Brier 等

dimensions.name: 适用性与可迁移性
dimensions.question: 研究结果是否适用于目标人群和地区
dimensions.observations: 间接性、外部验证、证据缺口、地区差异、资源可得性及无依据外推率

dimensions.name: 个体化决策
dimensions.question: 对这个人的条件是否作出有依据的调整
dimensions.observations: 相关条件敏感性、绝对效应、收益伤害、偏好整合、必要追问、明确未知

dimensions.name: 临床安全
dimensions.question: 是否遗漏会改变行动的重要危险
dimensions.observations: 严重错误问题根比例及输出级比例、禁忌与关键伤害遗漏、单位剂量错误、紧急情况处理

dimensions.name: 公平与稳健
dimensions.question: 表现差异与输入变化是否合理
dimensions.observations: 分组错误和拒答差异、无关扰动、重复稳定性、恶意文献指令抵抗；分别报子项

dimensions.name: 决策沟通与可用性
dimensions.question: 用户能否正确理解并采取适当行动
dimensions.observations: 风险理解、收益伤害表达、共享决策、问题回答完整性、误导性和返工需求

dimensions.name: 复现与过程完整性
dimensions.question: 第三方能否核查交付过程
dimensions.observations: 运行版本、来源清单、检索日志、分析复算、人员角色、变更和利益冲突披露

tracks.name: 临床证据问答
tracks.deliverable: 可核查的快速回答或证据简报
tracks.boundary: 不要求短答完成一篇正式综述

tracks.name: 系统综述与综合
tracks.deliverable: 检索、筛选、研究关联、提取、偏倚、统计及确定性
tracks.boundary: 成对、NMA、诊断、IPD 等分别冻结模块

tracks.name: 指南证据包
tracks.boundary: 正式指南的委员会、患者参与及外审须真实存在

tracks.name: 公众健康沟通
tracks.deliverable: 面向公众的健康建议、风险表达和辟谣
tracks.boundary: 加入目标使用者的理解与误解测量

tracks.name: 原始数据分析
tracks.deliverable: RWE、因果、预测及经济模型分析
tracks.boundary: 使用专用数据权限、方法和复算规则

tracks.name: 流程组件
tracks.deliverable: 检索、筛选、单篇评价、提取、RoB、统计等
tracks.boundary: 子任务表现不能代替全流程表现

tracks.name: 个体化证据支持
tracks.deliverable: 具体患者或决策者条件下的证据应用
tracks.boundary: 评价建议过程与证据适配；患者实际获益另做临床验证

evidence_modules.name: 干预效果
evidence_modules.evidence: 药物、手术、器械、康复、心理、运动、营养；个体或集群随机试验及非随机干预
evidence_modules.focus: 目标效应、收益伤害、独立性、偏倚、效应合成

evidence_modules.name: 诊断与检测
evidence_modules.evidence: 诊断、筛查、分期、实验室及影像检测
evidence_modules.focus: 阈值、参照标准、敏感度特异度、下游患者结局

evidence_modules.name: 预后与预测
evidence_modules.evidence: 预后因素、自然病程、传统或 AI 预测模型
evidence_modules.focus: 校准、区分度、外部验证、适用性；区分预测与因果

evidence_modules.name: 病因暴露与伤害
evidence_modules.evidence: 队列、病例对照、环境职业暴露、药物警戒
evidence_modules.focus: 混杂、选择偏倚、时间结构、因果外推

evidence_modules.name: 人群描述与疾病负担
evidence_modules.evidence: 患病率、发病率、调查与横断面研究
evidence_modules.focus: 抽样框架、代表性、测量和标准化；不强加因果解释

evidence_modules.name: 病例与罕见信号
evidence_modules.evidence: 病例报告、病例系列、罕见病线索
evidence_modules.focus: 信号价值和推断边界；不从单例确证疗效

evidence_modules.name: 证据综合
evidence_modules.evidence: 系统综述、成对 Meta、网络 Meta、诊断 Meta、IPD、剂量反应、范围及快速综述
evidence_modules.focus: 各设计专用方法；不宜合并时的判断
evidence_modules.sequence: 成对综合先行，其余扩展

evidence_modules.name: 指南与推荐
evidence_modules.evidence: 临床指南、公共健康及政策推荐、HTA 证据包
evidence_modules.focus: 证据确定性、EtD、地区适用、利益冲突和治理

evidence_modules.name: 定性与混合研究
evidence_modules.evidence: 体验、价值偏好、可接受性、实施障碍
evidence_modules.focus: 方法限制、主题综合、CERQual、混合证据整合

evidence_modules.name: 卫生经济学
evidence_modules.evidence: 成本效果、预算影响、模型研究、资源配置
evidence_modules.focus: 结构和输入假设、成本年份、阈值、敏感性及转移性

evidence_modules.name: 测量与患者报告结局
evidence_modules.evidence: 量表、PROM、生活质量、测量属性
evidence_modules.focus: 内容效度、可靠性、反应度及重要差异解释

evidence_modules.name: 公共与人群健康
evidence_modules.evidence: 疫苗、生活方式、预防、社会照护、健康不平等
evidence_modules.focus: 人群影响、实施、情境、可及性与公平

evidence_modules.name: 混合方法与实施
evidence_modules.evidence: 复杂干预、健康系统、政策和实施研究
evidence_modules.focus: 定量及定性组件、机制、情境、整合逻辑与实施可行性

evidence_modules.name: 真实世界与原始数据
evidence_modules.evidence: EHR、登记、理赔、调查、患者级数据
evidence_modules.focus: 缺失、测量、泄漏、因果识别、可复算与隐私

evidence_modules.name: 数字健康与临床 AI
evidence_modules.evidence: 模型、设备、工作流、多模态临床应用
evidence_modules.focus: 开发与验证、数据漂移、人因、临床影响
evidence_modules.sequence: 预测评估先行，部署扩展

evidence_modules.name: 证据不足与完整性
evidence_modules.evidence: 阴性或冲突证据、未报告亚组、勘误撤稿、预印本
evidence_modules.focus: 识别未知、不夸大、正确处理版本和撤稿影响

evidence_modules.name: 机制与临床前支持
evidence_modules.evidence: 动物、体外、机制、替代终点
evidence_modules.focus: 识别证据层级、转化限制；不能直接推出患者获益
evidence_modules.sequence: 边界任务，专用模块扩展

gates.name: 研究独立性与推断有效
重大伤害与更新得到处理
确定性与外推无危险夸大

statistics.serious_error_primary_event: At least one adjudicated serious error within each independent question root, with prefrozen variant and repeat counts; report output-level rate separately.

roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 覆盖矩阵、标准注册表、七赛道合同、参考和裁判规程、风险判例
roadmap.acceptance: 每个首批模块有适用单元、来源、版本和责任人；冻结开发与测试边界
roadmap.roles: 方法负责人、临床负责人、项目负责人
roadmap.service_deliverable: 冻结服务层级、范围、核查状态和计时口径

roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 从 12 个种子审定 12 至 24 个独立问题根；3 类代表系统试运行
roadmap.acceptance: 全部参考独立双审；来源可核查；无未解决的关键参考分歧；测出评审工时
roadmap.roles: 临床与方法评审、数据负责人、工程负责人
roadmap.service_deliverable: 即时初评、后台任务、进度查询与报价流程原型

roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 48 至 60 个问题根；约 4 至 6 个系统或流程；个体化对照和历史更新题
roadmap.acceptance: 一致性达到预注册目标；检查自动裁判偏差；用真实成本和方差重算正式规模
roadmap.roles: 统计负责人、评审组、工程负责人
roadmap.service_deliverable: 验证初评质量、P50/P95时延、专家容量和单位成本

roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 按功效与预算确认的题量；300 至 500 根为规划情景；启用可成熟验证模块
roadmap.acceptance: 无未解决关键参考问题；可独立复跑；至少一支外部团队验证；结果覆盖所有计划任务
roadmap.roles: 独立验证团队、统计与数据负责人
roadmap.service_deliverable: 仅在质量与容量均通过验收的模块开放相应服务

roadmap.window: 第 4 至 12 月，与冻结版并行
roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 持续证据事件、地区和语言验证、滚动保密集
roadmap.acceptance: 用真实事件及对照验证响应；公布未处理与删失；复核新旧版可比性
roadmap.roles: 更新编辑、专家组、工程与治理负责人

roadmap.window: 第 6 至 12 月及以后
roadmap.deliverables_and_scale_assumptions: 定性、经济、PROM、原始 RWE、NMA、IPD 等按模块进入
roadmap.acceptance: 每一扩展完成专用标准、参考、可靠性和外部验证后再启用

standard_registry.name: RoB 2
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Specific randomized intervention result; select design variant

standard_registry.name: ROBINS-I
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Do not silently replace frozen formal protocol with draft V2

standard_registry.name: ROBINS-E
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Follow-up exposure study result; not all observational designs

standard_registry.name: QUADAS-3
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Estimate-level diagnostic/screening/staging test accuracy

standard_registry.name: PROBAST+AI
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Prediction model development and performance evaluation; separate judgments

standard_registry.name: CONSORT
standard_registry.scope_caveat: RCT reporting; extensions need compatibility check

standard_registry.name: SPIRIT
standard_registry.scope_caveat: RCT protocol reporting

standard_registry.name: TRIPOD+AI
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Prediction model reporting

standard_registry.name: STARD-AI
standard_registry.scope_caveat: AI diagnostic accuracy reporting; not QUADAS-AI

standard_registry.name: QUADAS-AI
standard_registry.version_note: Development protocol verified; final tool not verified in this review
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Do not use as a verified final instrument

standard_registry.name: GRADE Book and applicable guidance
standard_registry.version_note: Book available from 2024; lock relevant chapter snapshot
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Outcome-specific certainty; not averaged as interval scores

standard_registry.name: PRISMA
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Reporting is not conduct or risk of bias

standard_registry.name: PRISMA-LSR
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Living systematic review reporting; not benchmark validity certification

standard_registry.name: AMSTAR 2
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Applicable intervention reviews; critical-domain logic; no item total

standard_registry.name: GRADE-CERQual
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Per qualitative synthesis finding

standard_registry.name: JBI critical appraisal tools
standard_registry.version_note: Analytical cross-sectional revised 2026; lock each tool
standard_registry.scope_caveat: No single JBI version for all designs

standard_registry.name: CHEERS
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Economic reporting; not economic model validity score

standard_registry.name: COSMIN PROM review guideline and RoB checklist
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Measurement property and tool version-specific

standard_registry.name: AGREE II
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Requires true process information where relevant

standard_registry.name: RIGHT
standard_registry.version_note: Original formal statement; update protocol not final version
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Not guideline quality assessment

standard_registry.name: TRIPOD-LLM
standard_registry.version_note: 2025 publication; no verified 2026 new version number
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Evaluation transparency, not clinical safety certification

standard_registry.name: IMDRF GMLP
standard_registry.scope_caveat: Device development principles; not approval of this benchmark
